question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'Occassion'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling would be 'Occasion'.**
 
• The word '**Occasion**' is a **noun** which means 'a particular event, or the time at which it takes place'. **(अवसर)**
 
 
• **For Example -**
 
• Her birthday was a joyful occasion for the whole family.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer would be **'Occassion'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Let’s understand the meanings of the other marked words -**

 
• **Efficient -** achieving maximum productivity with minimum wasted effort or expense **(कुशल)**
 
• **Boundary -** a line that marks the limits of an area; a dividing line **(सीमा)**
 
• **Illustration -** a picture or diagram that explains or decorates a text **(चित्रण)**
